independence_evidence: Published by TYPE01, a small type-media company (TYPE 01 Ltd, company 12024445, sole officer Amber Jane Weaver per Companies House) that also runs two type foundries and a font marketplace; no large media group involvement found (https://type-01.com/about/, https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/12024445/officers).
qualifies_reason: Independent UK typography magazine whose Issue 10 was published in print on 8 September 2025, with Issue 11 on pre-order for November 2026.
what_it_is: TYPEONE is an English-language print magazine about typography and graphic design, with studio interviews, opinion pieces, industry insight and career advice for designers. Each issue is themed and guest-edited (Issue 10, at 182 pages, was designed by Studio Groundfloor; Issue 11 covers wayfinding), and alternate limited-edition covers are common. It is aimed at graphic designers, type designers and students.

uncertainties: typeonemagazine.com now redirects to an unrelated 'coming soon' page (iconyc.cc); the live publisher site is type-01.com. Issue 11 (The Wayfinding Issue, GBP 24.99) is on pre-order with 'Shipping: November' 2026 and was not yet confirmed shipped on 2026-11-17, so Issue 10 is recorded as the latest issue out. City is the registered office of TYPE 01 Ltd (Walton-on-Thames, Surrey); the site itself gives no address and the magazine is often described as London-based. The about page calls the magazine annual, though earlier issues were roughly biannual.
